title: Generalize agent conversation continuation for implementation and review agents
specification:
# PRD: Generalize agent conversation continuation for implementation and review agents

Priority: High

## Problem
Conversation continuation is currently implementation-agent specific. Implementation follow-ups can resume the original Codex session, but review agents for the same task/PR only receive prompt context such as review round and prior reviews, so reviewer reasoning continuity is not preserved across review rounds.

## Goal
Introduce a generalized per-agent conversation continuation model so implementation and review agents can each resume their own prior Codex conversation when handling the same task/PR, while keeping conversations isolated by role and falling back safely when continuation is unavailable.

## Requirements
- Introduce a generalized conversation reference model for task/PR agent runs, keyed by agent role or agent ID, instead of relying only on `implementationConversationId`.
- Preserve backward compatibility with existing implementation conversation IDs, including migration or compatibility mapping where needed.
- Persist Codex session IDs returned from implementation runs and reviewer runs when available.
- When implementation follow-up tasks are created after `changes_requested`, continue carrying the original implementation agent conversation reference.
- When reviewer tasks run for the same task/PR, attempt to resume the prior reviewer conversation for that same review agent before starting a fresh reviewer session.
- Keep implementation and reviewer conversation references separate; never reuse reviewer sessions for implementation or implementation sessions for review.
- If resume fails, the conversation is expired, or no prior session exists, fall back to the existing explicit task/PR/diff/prior-review prompt context.
- Do not add durable transcript/history UI or store full conversation transcripts as part of this change.
- Update reviewer task records, queue metadata, or PR review state as needed so reviewer continuation survives normal task lifecycle transitions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Implementation behavior from the completed PRD still works with the generalized model.
- Reviewer runs for the same task/PR record a reviewer conversation ID when available.
- A subsequent reviewer run for the same task/PR attempts to resume the prior reviewer conversation.
- Reviewer resume failure falls back to the existing reviewer prompt flow without blocking review execution.
- Implementation and reviewer session IDs are stored and resumed independently.
- Existing task records with `implementationConversationId` continue to work or are mapped into the new generalized structure.
- Tests cover persistence, lookup, role isolation, resume success, and fallback behavior for both implementation and review agents.

## Verification
- Add or update unit tests for generalized conversation reference persistence and backward compatibility with `implementationConversationId`.
- Add unit tests proving implementation follow-up tasks still carry and resume the implementation conversation reference.
- Add unit tests proving reviewer tasks store and resume reviewer conversation references for the same task/PR.
- Add unit tests proving reviewer and implementation conversation IDs are never cross-used.
- Add runner tests for resume success and resume unavailable fallback for reviewer runs.
- Run `npm run typecheck` and the relevant task runner, reviewer runner, and queue lifecycle tests.
